title: Physics-constrained neural networks for surrogate modeling of lossless periodic structures
abstract: arXiv:2606.28119v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a physics-constrained neural network for the rapid prediction of rigorous coupled-wave analysis outputs in the form of Jones matrices. Starting from energy conservation in lossless layered periodic structures, we use the fact that the scattering outputs lie on a Stiefel manifold. This energy constraint is enforced as a hard condition by projecting onto the manifold using differentiable symmetric orthogonalization. The resulting surrogate enforces energy conservation by construction while preserving differentiability for gradient-based inverse design. The performance and generality of the proposed approach are demonstrated through the inverse design of a diffractive waveguide combiner for augmented reality glasses.

translated_title: 用于无损周期结构代理建模的物理约束神经网络
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种物理约束神经网络，用于快速预测以琼斯矩阵形式表示的严格耦合波分析输出。从无损层状周期结构中的能量守恒出发，我们利用散射输出位于Stiefel流形上这一事实。通过使用可微对称正交化将结果投影到该流形上，这一能量约束被作为硬条件加以强制实施。由此得到的代理模型在构造上即保证了能量守恒，同时保持了可微性以支持基于梯度的逆向设计。通过对用于增强现实眼镜的衍射波导组合器进行逆向设计，验证了所提方法的性能和通用性。
tldr: 该论文提出一种通过可微对称正交化投影到Stiefel流形来硬性保证能量守恒的物理约束神经网络代理模型，能够快速预测无损周期结构的琼斯矩阵并支持基于梯度的逆向设计，成功应用于增强现实衍射波导组合器的设计。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a physics-constrained neural network surrogate that enforces energy conservation as a hard constraint via differentiable symmetric orthogonalization onto the Stiefel manifold, enabling rapid prediction of Jones matrices for lossless periodic structures and supporting gradient-based inverse design, as demonstrated on AR diffractive waveguide combiners.
